Caveat: exploits can also be crafted data (malformed file, serialized payload) that is not Software, and there is no may-use verb to hedge with, so a uses d3f:Software row would overclaim. Leave this as an honest no-fit (the ATT&CK seed T1588.005 is unmapped too) rather than force a row.

AML.T0016.004.note: AIToolDefinition under DigitalInformation (content) is a real gap; this parent should be the one canonical parent, since T0110.000 proposes the same name under ApplicationConfiguration.

AML.T0017.001.note: Same role problem as T0016.003. Replace the proposal with a may-create d3f:Software row (quote: develop or materially adapt an exploit capability); may- because the exploit capability is not always code.

AML.T0017.002.note: AIToolDefinition under DigitalInformation is consistent with T0016.004.

AML.T0018.003.note: AIPromptConfiguration under ApplicationConfiguration is a reasonable specialization (chat templates and tokenizer settings configure the inference runtime); a may-modify ApplicationConfiguration row would already be true today.

AML.T0085.002.note: AIAgentMemoryRecord under Record is a real gap (cross-session memory, poisoning-relevant); the DigitalMessage row is the parent of MITRE's AIInteractionMessage.

AML.T0085.003.note: Same AIPromptConfiguration parent as T0018.003, consistent; the row verb should be accesses.

AML.T0110.000.note: AIToolDefinition must be under DigitalInformation to match T0016.004/T0017.002, since tool descriptions are model-visible content, not app settings; verb should be modifies, not may-modify.

AML.T0110.001.note: Residual flag fine; implementation is Software, definition layer belongs to T0110.000.

AML.T0110.002.note: A future AIInteractionMessage (or tool-result) child of DigitalMessage would be the specific target.

AML.T0115.note: Parent row killed; children carry dataset/model/tool restrictions (#608 collapse would only give DigitalInformation).

AML.T0115.000.note: A dataset is content that can span many files or a table, so Dataset belongs under DigitalInformation (parallel to AIModel), not File. Training is a downstream victim event (AML.T0020) the publisher takes no part in, and MachineLearningTrainingEvent does not exist on develop.

AML.T0115.001.note: AIModel under DigitalInformation matches MITRE's preferred name and parent.
